claims.text: Chickenpox fever: acetaminophen; avoid aspirin (Reye syndrome)
claims.quote: Acetaminophen may reduce fever; however, aspirin should be avoided as it may cause Reye syndrome.

claims.text: Zoster: wet compresses soothe, but systemic analgesics are often necessary
claims.quote: Wet compresses are soothing, but systemic analgesics are often necessary.
